scope: Mechanism and historical replay only, original training intakes 01 to 07, both seats, first qualifying change per episode. No approval on observed income or wins. Retained source commands came from the frozen v1 against original Master3s2. Future full-game development must use a separately preregistered new pair of maps after a verified public mechanism on both physical seats.
inputs: Candidate seat's currently visible workers, trees, balance, filtered carbon; latest positive or observed-zero carbon seen by own worker within 6 previous moves, discounted to 0.90^age, and the currently issued parent joint command. No hidden cell, future command, examiner state or environment seed. Existing dual actor and its conditional trunk correction are preserved. Reset history every episode and on a physical-seat change.
limits: At most one RECPLANTER to RECCOLLECTOR per whole game, with at least one live planter, same dynamically priced worker, an actually affordable base and a remaining worker slot. At least three stays, two traversals and a three-turn slack before termination. No extra cash reserve for equal-wage substitution.
travel: A home base to a distance 1-3 known carbon tile and back. Use a shortest path clear of current enemy attack or friendly same-turn destination on outbound squares. A target must have no base/tree, no friendly collector already within one, and no current hostile worker within two. Current/recent carbon discounted for age and for 4-neighbour tree drains across outward moves and three stationary harvests. Candidate projected bank after movement and smelt must exceed the wage by at least five units. This is an opportunity estimate, not a guaranteed return or a plan imposed on the v1 actor.
tree_veto: Retain planter when a publicly identifiable opponent tree within two of the base has at least eight turns left to seize, or an unoccupied nearby new-tree site has the visible four-neighbour stock to repay the true planting price plus five over at most twelve turns. Existing friendly planter within one may cover a site, and that covered site alone does not veto. Do not spend a hypothetical extra hire reserve.
prefix: Recompute the frozen v1 chosen branch with hypothetical base command forced in native decoder; require that all actions except the selected base remain unchanged. Decline any malformed/illegal or ambiguous branch.
mechanism: Screen ALL registered source seats, source/board/pack identity verified, inspect both physical seats including inactive roots and veto reasons. Reconstruct public trail and candidate/parent exact orders on selected archived training games. Require at least one genuine override per seat for future map registration; if absent, record the unknown or unobserved step without relaxing the criteria on the same set.
evaluation: Synthetic counterexamples for changed price, cash/cap, occupancy, short horizon, risky destination and valuable local tree opportunity; prove zero change past first activation and for other units. Audit near-term income as descriptive only when branches were not separately run against an actual reacting opponent.
